text:
nate (Finance): Heads up — Invoice 2198 (Orion ML) marked overdue, customer disputes charges; submitted a formal chargeback to their bank claiming duplicate usage.
olga (Collections): Did they provide dates and screenshots? Need specifics to loop AM and legal.
tyler (Support): Customer says they were double-billed for 2025-04-01 batch. Attached csv export and usage dashboard link: https://redwood.ai/usage/orion-2198
maya (Sales): I asked their billing contact for the chargeback case number and confirmation from their bank. They also offered a 60% payment now if we drop the duplicate usage.
nate (Finance): We should validate duplicate usage in logs. If it's our mistake, refund the duplicate tokens and accept 60% now, 40% on net15. If not, we hold. @payments-bot run usage-compare 2198 --date 2025-04-01
payments-bot: Running usage diff... result: 1 duplicated session (session_id: s-9f3b) with 1,200 tokens overlap. Potential billing delta: $144.
olga (Collections): Small delta. Recommend offering credit of $144 and require full payment for remainder. Counter-offer: apply credit for duplicate, accept 60% now, 40% net15, sign waiver that closes chargeback.
maya (Sales): Customer prefers immediate resolution; willing to sign waiver. They want confirmation that we won't pursue collection once waiver signed.
nate (Finance): Finance will issue a credit memo for $144 and generate split invoices. Need written waiver template from legal. @olga start hold-flow once first payment clears.
olga (Collections): Will do. Also flag to AM that if chargeback is reversed by bank, we refund the credited amount and adjust ledger.
tyler (Support): I fixed the ingestion bug that caused the duplicate session and deployed patch at 2179005000. Logging improved.
nate (Finance): Good. payments-bot create invoices: 2198-A ($80,000 - 60%), 2198-B ($53,856 - 40% minus $144 credit applied). Links?
payments-bot: Invoices created: 2198-A link https://pay.redwood.ai/pay/2198-A, 2198-B link https://pay.redwood.ai/pay/2198-B. Credit memo CM-2198 for $144 created.
maya (Sales): Sent links and waiver to customer. They authorized payment via card for 2198-A.
olga (Collections): Once card clears, set account status to 'payment-plan' and pause escalation. If chargeback still open after 30 days, escalate to legal.
nate (Finance): Noted. Please attach chargeback case # when received. Closing for now.
